description: Accept a quote. IMPORTANT: this does not confirm execution. The request enters pending_review; a human operator confirms or declines each request individually during the launch phase. No timeline is promised. Poll get_task_status for the outcome. Payment: pay_with 'card' (default, Stripe), 'paypal' (PayPal Checkout — the response carries payment_instructions with an approval_url to approve in PayPal), or 'jpyc' / 'usdc' to pay in stablecoins on Polygon — the response then carries payment_instructions with the exact amount (including a unique fractional tail that identifies your transfer) and the receiving address.
